text: Harbour City’s transit authority on Tuesday unveiled the Corvane E3 delivery van, saying the battery-powered vehicle will be used for parcels and maintenance runs across the district. Officials said the van’s stated range is 510 kilometres on a single charge, with full charging possible overnight at depot stations. The first six vans will enter service next month, replacing older diesel units on short-haul routes. Transit commissioner Leena Voss said the fleet upgrade is expected to cut fuel costs and reduce roadside emissions. “This is a practical step for our operations and our climate targets,” Voss said. The authority said it spent 4.8 million crowns on the initial rollout.
